title: Global Email Layout
subtitle: Edit the MJML layout that wraps all email templates. Use \{{content}} where template content should appear.

placeholder.description: Insert \{{content}} where email content should appear. The preview replaces it with sample content. Note: all text in MJML must be inside tags like <mj-section><mj-column><mj-text>your text</mj-text></mj-column></mj-section> — plain text outside tags is silently ignored.

preview.emptyPlaceholder: Start editing the MJML layout to see a preview.
preview.mjmlWarnings: MJML warnings (content may not render as expected)
